title: 381. Move Zeroes

examples.explanation: Non-zeros keep order [1,3,12]; zeros shift to the end.
The zero moves past the trailing 1.

hints: Adaptation: the original moves zeros in place with void; here return the rearranged array.
Two pointers: write each non-zero to the next free slot, then fill the tail with zeros.
Relative order of non-zeros is preserved.
